title: Hotaru no Yomeiri: Choitashi

thread.title: Firefly Wedding • Hotaru no Yomeiri - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Most commenters enjoyed the central romance, especially the leads’ increasingly comfortable and playful dynamic.
Many found the episode’s emotional material affecting and praised its themes of loneliness, freedom, and mutual reassurance.
The humor was frequently well received, particularly the contrast between Shinpei’s menace and Satoko’s blunt, confident reactions.
Several commenters liked the supporting character introductions and were hopeful about friendlier relationships developing.
Commenters were intrigued by Shinpei’s tragic background but remained uneasy about his violence and unstable morality.
The apparent escape plan generated optimism, but many suspected it was too convenient and expected complications.
Some reactions criticized the simplistic or irritating behavior of the jealous women introduced near the episode’s end.
